_doc: Per-region orthophoto metadata. Placement: centre_utm + size_m +
rotation_deg (from in-viewer 'P' key). enabled=false skips ortho
stage at bake time. area_radius_m turns the per-voxel sample into
a 3x3 grid in a square of side 2*radius and keeps the most-
saturated pick — fixes lane stripes / kerb paint getting washed
out by surrounding asphalt at cell-sized resolution.
Past placements kept for reference. ortho_loader ignores keys

v1_zoom18_full_roi.note: V-World zoom 18 fetch, full ROI. Dim source.

v3_partial_roi_misnamed.note: 1250x600 PNG with ROI aspect but actually only covers up to the tunnel entrance — placing it at full-ROI centre/size produced an alignment that was 'completely off' per user. Kept here as a warning: aspect alone doesn't prove coverage.

deoksong._note: v2 finalised. saturation 1.8 added back: source pink lane patch is RGB ~(200,175,170) → saturation ~0.15 raw. Even with nearest-neighbour preserving the pixel, a 0.15-sat patch reads grey-ish on screen, so we boost AFTER sampling. Applied uniformly to ortho-recoloured and LIDAR-fallback voxels (latter is mostly outside the v2 rectangle anyway).
